description: This file defines the RequestBodySubscriber class, which subscribes to Symfony's Kernel request events and processes JSON request bodies to populate request parameters in a PHP-based HRM system.

classes.name: RequestBodySubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for Symfony Kernel request events and processes JSON request bodies for the HRM system.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the Kernel request event to the subscriber callback with its priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event; if the request's content type is JSON, decodes the JSON content and adds it to request parameters.
